title: Full-spectrum gradient

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Connect individual palette colors through a continuous field so color can act as one recognizable signature.
strategic_value: The continuous warm-to-violet field can retain Instagram recognition without relying on a large glyph.
demonstration: Five sampling rings sit across the gradient; a five-dot legend below names it Full-spectrum gradient.
practical_value: Read the solid colors as parts of a continuous gradient rather than unrelated swatches.

content_islands.name: Gradient field
content_islands.spec: Fill the wide upper area with smooth yellow, orange, pink and violet transitions.

content_islands.name: Sampling key
content_islands.spec: Place white sampling circles on the field and the five-dot key centered below.

reference_purposes.Expression: The gradient specimen and sampling rings show the palette as a continuous field.
reference_purposes.Application: The key connects the gradient to its five constituent color positions.

ingredient.name: Full-spectrum gradient
ingredient.role: Act as a continuous color signature.
ingredient.application: Use the shown continuous transitions when studying the full-spectrum treatment.
ingredient.scope: This specimen does not supply gradient coordinates, timing or area requirements.
